summary: Interstate Power and Light Company filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) on August 18, 2026, for a proposed offering of senior debentures due 20__. The offering is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. The company will pay interest semi-annually and may redeem the debentures at specified prices, including a tax credit event redemption at 101%. The debentures are unsecured senior obligations in minimum denominations of $2,000. Joint book-running managers are Mizuho, PNC Capital Markets, US Bancorp, and Wells Fargo Securities. The filing includes standard risk factors and use of proceeds, with no unusual structural features or event-driven catalysts.
